posts.raw_content:
Good afternoon frens,

I’d like to welcome you to our new future.  While there are not many positives I can think of about yesterday’s performance, I believe we still have an opportunity to make America what we need it to be.  We have lost to the uniparty. We lost to the media. What did we get done in the past 2 years? Nothing.  Our Republican controlled congress has been an utter failure and a democrat controlled congress will not change anything other than we get more peach mints. 

What is your mandate?  You’re charged with doing more.  Do more in your community.  Get more involved in everyday politics.  Relying on finding a new Trump or better Trump isn’t something possible to save our country.  We have done nothing other than slightly delayed the slow progression of liberalism in our country.  Becoming bitter isn’t an option. Our responsibility is the same as it was yesterday. Hoping someone else will come and save you isn’t going to happen. Your job is work hard, stay engaged, support like minded individuals. Find a future for yourself and others you love.  Spread the message of making our country great and continue to push hard against:

Men in women’s sports 
Mothers killing their children 
An open border 
Muslim destruction of our laws
Anything else we have previously stood against we stand against now. 

We have not seen the worst of everything and I don’t intend on lying about that.  I cannot foresee the future but I can promise that I’ll stand by my friends here and work to make it the best future possible. Take yesterday and today as a loss.  Admit it isn’t as ideal as a resounding victory. Accept disappointment today and when you are done it’s time to move on. Stay strong get back to work.  The future of our country doesn’t belong to the media, the uniparty or billionaires.  It belongs to you and it’s imperative that we never give up on ourselves. 

I stand with you.
